title: 写作常用搭配
description: 写作中组织论证、衔接上下文的表达：as a result、in terms of、give rise to、on the other hand……

entries.example: Without bee pollination, California's almond crop, for example, would be non-existent.
entries.translation: 例如，如果没有蜜蜂授粉，加利福尼亚的杏仁作物就不复存在了。

entries.example: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
entries.translation: 我们优化了数据库索引，结果系统效率提高了50%。

entries.example: I was late as a result of the train delay.
entries.translation: 由于火车晚点，我迟到了。

entries.example: In addition to a blocked nose, I'm also suffering from a high temperature.
entries.translation: 除了鼻子不通以外，我还发着高烧。

entries.example: First of all, you should talk it over with your parents.
entries.translation: 首先，你应该和你的父母谈谈。

entries.example: On the one hand, you are wrong, but on the other hand, I can't blame you for that.
entries.translation: 一方面你错了，但另一方面，我也不能因此责怪你。

entries.example: Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.
entries.translation: 人类与动物的不同之处在于他们能思考和说话。

entries.example: I've no way of telling whether or not what he says is true.
entries.translation: 我无法判断他的话是真是假。

entries.example: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
entries.translation: 我完全不知道他为什么突然辞职。

entries.example: Compared to his brother, he's not so wise.
entries.translation: 和他兄弟相比，他不够聪明。

entries.example: Everybody's hard work contributed to the show's success.
entries.translation: 大家的努力促成了演出的成功。

entries.example: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
entries.translation: 这项政策导致物价大幅上涨。

entries.example: That accounts for why the door was open.
entries.translation: 这就解释了门为什么开着。

entries.example: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
entries.translation: 另外，稍后我们还会颁发“本月最佳员工”奖。

entries.example: The accident was due to his careless driving.
entries.translation: 这起事故是由于他粗心驾驶造成的。

entries.example: In general, women live longer than men.
entries.translation: 一般来说，女性比男性寿命长。

entries.example: He says what he thinks regardless of other people's feelings.
entries.translation: 他想说什么就说什么，不顾别人的感受。

entries.example: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
entries.translation: 两者都可以，但前者更简洁。

entries.example: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
entries.translation: 就公共交通而言，这家酒店的位置很方便。

entries.example: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
entries.translation: 我们因准备不足而失败了。

entries.example: I do this job not for the money, but rather for my happiness.
entries.translation: 我做这份工作不是为了钱，而是为了自己开心。

entries.example: I gave up smoking for the sake of my health.
entries.translation: 为了健康，我戒了烟。

entries.example: He promised to return and yet he didn't.
entries.translation: 他答应会回来，然而却没有。

entries.example: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
entries.translation: 首先，我想宣布几项新规定。

entries.example: He is nothing more than an egoist.
entries.translation: 他只不过是个自私自利的人。

entries.example: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
entries.translation: 在很多人的印象中，五声音阶往往与中国音乐挂钩。

entries.example: The game was called off on account of the rain.
entries.translation: 比赛因下雨而取消了。

entries.example: It may rain tomorrow, but we are going in any case.
entries.translation: 明天可能会下雨，但无论如何我们都会去。

entries.example: Practice is as important as theory, but we are apt to value the latter and despise the former.
entries.translation: 实践和理论同样重要，但我们倾向于重视后者而忽略前者。

entries.example: The speaker didn't know his subject, nor did he speak well; in short, he was disappointing.
entries.translation: 演讲者不熟悉自己的主题，也讲得不好；简而言之，他令人失望。

entries.example: It gets very humid here in the summer. In the winter, on the other hand, it gets very dry.
entries.translation: 这里夏天非常潮湿，而冬天则非常干燥。

entries.example: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
entries.translation: 委员会由三男七女组成。

entries.example: That's the best approach to the study of English.
entries.translation: 那是学习英语的最佳方法。

entries.example: She doesn't pay attention to others; in other words, she is selfish.
entries.translation: 她不关心别人；换句话说，她很自私。

entries.example: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
entries.translation: 我代表公司欢迎你。

entries.example: They have provided the library with a large number of books.
entries.translation: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。

entries.example: Compared with yours, my car is small.
entries.translation: 和你的车比起来，我的车很小。

entries.example: The result was contrary to our plan.
entries.translation: 结果与我们的计划相反。

entries.example: Each man stood up in turn and introduced himself.
entries.translation: 每位男士依次站起来做了自我介绍。

entries.example: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
entries.translation: 从天色上判断，今天下午可能会下雨。

entries.example: We took action immediately so that things wouldn't get worse.
entries.translation: 为了避免情况恶化，我们马上采取了行动。

entries.example: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
entries.translation: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

entries.example: She speaks German and French, not to mention English.
entries.translation: 她会说德语和法语，更不用说英语了。

entries.example: Mother was busily cooking; in the meantime, I was just watching TV.
entries.translation: 妈妈忙着做饭；与此同时，我只是在看电视。

entries.example: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
entries.translation: 工厂废料导致了严重的环境污染。

entries.example: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
entries.translation: 总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。

entries.example: In this way, we waste a lot of time.
entries.translation: 这样一来，我们会浪费很多时间。

entries.example: I came to this country for the purpose of studying music.
entries.translation: 我来这个国家的目的是学习音乐。

entries.example: In a sense, I can understand his confusion.
entries.translation: 在某种意义上，我能理解他的困惑。

entries.example: The planning committee met six times over the course of ten months.
entries.translation: 规划委员会在十个月里一共开了六次会。

entries.example: To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
entries.translation: 首先，我们必须解决这个问题。

entries.example: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
entries.translation: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。

entries.example: He expressed his feelings in the form of a painting.
entries.translation: 他以绘画的形式表达了自己的感情。

entries.example: We discussed a wide range of topics.
entries.translation: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。

entries.example: In comparison, taking the train is cheaper.
entries.translation: 相比之下，坐火车更便宜。

entries.example: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.
entries.translation: 坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。

entries.example: The accident stemmed from her negligence.
entries.translation: 这起事故源于她的疏忽。

entries.example: I want to go abroad, for instance, to Italy and Spain.
entries.translation: 我想出国，比如去意大利和西班牙。

entries.example: He did pioneering work in the field of physical geography.
entries.translation: 他在自然地理学领域做了开创性的工作。

entries.example: We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.
entries.translation: 我们得出结论，这个计划目前不可行。

entries.example: He's doing in-depth research on ancient history.
entries.translation: 他正在对古代历史进行深入研究。

entries.example: This is a useful book and, what is more, it is not expensive.
entries.translation: 这是一本有用的书，而且不贵。

entries.example: I'm traveling on a tight schedule. I don't have the time.
entries.translation: 我行程很紧，没有时间。

entries.example: Our top priority is to settle the dispute once and for all.
entries.translation: 我们的首要任务是彻底解决这场争端。

entries.example: Don't draw attention to yourself.
entries.translation: 别引人注意。

entries.example: We went to Paris in the course of our travels.
entries.translation: 我们在旅行途中去了巴黎。

entries.example: I agree with what you say to some extent.
entries.translation: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。

entries.example: He wanted to succeed, even at the cost of his health.
entries.translation: 他想要成功，即使是以自己的健康为代价。

entries.example: Please give my best regards to your parents.
entries.translation: 请代我向你父母致以诚挚的问候。

entries.example: The company cut its prices in an effort to attract more young customers.
entries.translation: 公司降低了价格，试图吸引更多年轻顾客。

entries.example: The north of the country is very dry; in contrast, the south stays green all year.
entries.translation: 这个国家的北部非常干燥，相比之下，南部全年都是绿的。

entries.example: In response to customer concerns, we will definitely be addressing this software defect.
entries.translation: 针对客户的担忧，我们一定会解决这个软件缺陷。

entries.example: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
entries.translation: 她定期去看牙医，所以很少牙痛。

entries.example: Today, these important habitats are threatened by a range of human activities.
entries.translation: 如今，这些重要栖息地正受到一系列人类活动的威胁。

entries.example: We must take the cost into consideration before making a final decision.
entries.translation: 在做最终决定之前，我们必须考虑成本。

entries.example: Reaction is not always the best course of action.
entries.translation: 反应并不总是最好的行动方案。

entries.example: I found the rumor to be true to a certain extent.
entries.translation: 我发现这个谣言在某种程度上是真的。

entries.example: The police are making every effort to look into the case.
entries.translation: 警方正尽一切努力调查此案。

entries.example: The police arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.
entries.translation: 警方逮捕了一名与这起抢劫案有关的嫌疑人。

entries.example: The report examines in depth the causes of the recent economic crisis.
entries.translation: 这份报告深入探讨了最近经济危机的成因。

entries.example: I will accept the work, provided that you help me.
entries.translation: 我将接受这份工作，前提是你能帮我。

entries.example: She must have studied in France, given that she speaks French fluently.
entries.translation: 她法语说得这么流利，肯定在法国学习过。

entries.example: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
entries.translation: 在我看来，汽车弊大于利。

entries.example: First and foremost, I'd like to thank everyone for coming.
entries.translation: 首先，我想感谢各位的到来。

entries.example: For one thing, I've no money, and for another, I've no leisure.
entries.translation: 一来我没钱，二来我没时间。

entries.example: The project was a failure, but it did pave the way for the success of later efforts.
entries.translation: 这个项目失败了，但它确实为后来各项努力的成功铺平了道路。

entries.example: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
entries.translation: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

entries.example: A society's values are reflected in its traditions.
entries.translation: 一个社会的价值观体现在它的传统之中。

entries.example: The left frontal lobe plays a role in controlling mood and emotion.
entries.translation: 左额叶在控制情绪和情感方面发挥作用。

entries.example: I think there's only a slim chance of that happening.
entries.translation: 我认为那种事发生的可能性很小。

entries.example: In contrast to his frightening looks, his voice was kind and calm.
entries.translation: 与他吓人的外表形成对比，他的声音温和而平静。

entries.example: I am writing in relation to your complaint.
entries.translation: 我写信是为了你投诉的事。

entries.example: It's common knowledge that the earth turns on its axis.
entries.translation: 众所周知，地球绕轴自转。

entries.example: Usefulness must be combined with pleasantness.
entries.translation: 实用性必须与愉悦感相结合。

entries.example: I can't tell you the whole story now, but in brief, my parents aren't coming here this summer.
entries.translation: 我现在没法把整件事告诉你，但简而言之，我父母今年夏天不会来这里。

entries.example: The buildings are small in comparison to the skyscrapers in New York.
entries.translation: 与纽约的摩天大楼相比，这些建筑很小。

entries.example: We are faced with a host of problems.
entries.translation: 我们面临着许多问题。

entries.example: Testing has been delayed by two days. As a consequence, we need to reschedule the release date.
entries.translation: 测试延迟了两天，因此我们需要重新安排发布日期。

entries.example: The smell is characteristic of garlic.
entries.translation: 这种气味是大蒜所特有的。

entries.example: Koalas are vulnerable to bushfires due to their slow movements.
entries.translation: 由于行动缓慢，考拉很容易受到丛林大火的伤害。

entries.example: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
entries.translation: 与城市生活相比，乡村生活非常宁静。

entries.example: We carry out some research into the causes of brain damage.
entries.translation: 我们对脑损伤的成因做了一些研究。

entries.example: Taro has a really strong sense of responsibility.
entries.translation: 太郎有很强的责任感。

entries.example: This solution is not workable in the long term.
entries.translation: 从长远来看，这个解决方案行不通。

entries.example: Beyond that I cannot help you.
entries.translation: 除此之外，我帮不了你。

entries.example: By definition, an acute angle is less than 90 degrees.
entries.translation: 按照定义，锐角小于90度。

entries.example: The policeman called attention to the problem of pickpockets.
entries.translation: 警察提醒人们注意扒手问题。

entries.example: He made a speech in support of the plan.
entries.translation: 他发表讲话支持这项计划。

entries.example: You have to raise funds for the relief work.
entries.translation: 你必须为救援工作筹集资金。

entries.example: How can we have any self-respect if we don't even try to make our goals a reality?
entries.translation: 如果我们连努力实现自己的目标都不做，又怎么会有自尊呢？

entries.example: He cited, during his speech, Kant and Heidegger among others.
entries.translation: 他在演讲中提到了康德和海德格尔等人。

entries.example: The story is consistent with the evidence.
entries.translation: 这个故事与证据相符。

entries.example: The conclusion was formed on the basis of these facts.
entries.translation: 这个结论是在这些事实的基础上形成的。

entries.example: To conclude, the project was a success despite the many difficulties we faced.
entries.translation: 总而言之，尽管我们面临许多困难，这个项目还是成功了。

entries.example: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.
entries.translation: 她很漂亮，聪明，并且最重要的是，她有一颗善良的心。

entries.example: A fridge that works well saves a considerable amount of energy.
entries.translation: 一台运转良好的冰箱能节省相当多的能源。

entries.example: Is this a common practice in Boston?
entries.translation: 这在波士顿是常见做法吗？

entries.example: We must take measures to prevent traffic accidents.
entries.translation: 我们必须采取措施防止交通事故。

entries.example: Please note the change in the meeting agenda.
entries.translation: 请注意会议议程的变更。

entries.example: To what extent did he play a part in the research project?
entries.translation: 他在这个研究项目中起了多大作用？

entries.example: I'm not here to put pressure on you.
entries.translation: 我不是来给你施压的。

entries.example: He studied hard with the intention of passing the examination.
entries.translation: 他努力学习，为的是通过考试。

entries.example: I think things will get trickier as time goes on.
entries.translation: 我觉得随着时间的推移，事情会变得越来越棘手。

entries.example: Such magazines have a great influence on children.
entries.translation: 这类杂志对儿童有很大的影响。

entries.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
entries.translation: 多运动有益健康。

entries.example: The laws apply to everyone irrespective of race, creed or color.
entries.translation: 法律适用于每个人，不论种族、信仰或肤色。

entries.example: He stayed behind in view of possible danger.
entries.translation: 考虑到可能有危险，他留了下来。

entries.example: The crop suffered serious damage as a consequence of the early frost.
entries.translation: 由于早霜，庄稼遭受了严重损害。

entries.example: Documents relating to his private life were stolen in the burglary.
entries.translation: 与他的私生活有关的文件在入室盗窃中被偷走了。

entries.example: Try to take account of everything before you make a decision.
entries.translation: 在做决定之前，尽量考虑到所有事情。

entries.example: The pandemic is having an impact on many couples and their relationships.
entries.translation: 疫情正在对许多夫妻及其关系产生影响。

entries.example: Travelling causes a significant amount of pollution.
entries.translation: 旅行会造成大量污染。

entries.example: Doing something meaningful can give you a sense of purpose in life.
entries.translation: 做有意义的事情能给你带来人生目标感。

entries.example: The new traffic regulations come into force tomorrow.
entries.translation: 新的交通法规明天开始生效。

entries.example: It took us three hours to come to a conclusion.
entries.translation: 我们花了三个小时才得出结论。

entries.example: In the city, large quantities of garbage are being produced every day.
entries.translation: 这座城市每天都会产生大量垃圾。

entries.example: The revised timetable will go into effect on the 5th of this month.
entries.translation: 修订后的时刻表将于本月5日生效。

entries.example: Simply put, a human being is an aggregate of many cells.
entries.translation: 简单地说，人是由许多细胞组成的集合体。

entries.example: The population of the world increases at a rate of two percent a year.
entries.translation: 世界人口以每年百分之二的速度增长。

entries.example: To sum up, we can say that his new novel is disappointing.
entries.translation: 总而言之，我们可以说他的新小说令人失望。

entries.example: I come from the Mediterranean region and more precisely, from Algeria.
entries.translation: 我来自地中海地区，更准确地说，来自阿尔及利亚。

entries.example: Chinese doesn't emphasize words in the same way as English.
entries.translation: 汉语不像英语那样强调单词。

entries.example: I started to learn English with the aim of becoming a teacher.
entries.translation: 我开始学英语，目标是成为一名教师。

entries.example: He is an expert in the area of city planning.
entries.translation: 他是城市规划方面的专家。

entries.example: His statement doesn't leave room for any doubt.
entries.translation: 他的陈述没有给任何怀疑留下余地。

entries.example: In the first place, it's too expensive, and in the second place, I don't like it.
entries.translation: 首先，它太贵了；其次，我不喜欢它。

entries.example: The home team always have an advantage over their opponents.
entries.translation: 主队总是比对手有优势。

entries.example: He looked quite happy in contrast with those around him.
entries.translation: 和周围的人相比，他显得相当快乐。

entries.example: A good book can completely absorb your attention, to the extent that you forget your surroundings and even your existence.
entries.translation: 一本好书能完全吸引你的注意力，以至于你忘记周围环境甚至自己的存在。

entries.example: I was late for the meeting with the result that I missed the most important part.
entries.translation: 我开会迟到了，结果错过了最重要的部分。

entries.example: His designs have broken new ground but his wife doesn't know it.
entries.translation: 他的设计有所突破，但他妻子并不知道。

entries.example: The road was quite muddy, and, what is worse, it began to rain.
entries.translation: 道路非常泥泞，更糟的是，天开始下雨了。

entries.example: The new evidence may bear on how the accident happened.
entries.translation: 新证据可能关系到事故是如何发生的。

entries.surface: requires a great deal of commitment of
entries.example: The training program requires a great deal of commitment of its participants.
entries.translation: 这个培训项目要求参与者付出极大的投入。

entries.example: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.
entries.translation: 他节俭，甚至可以说吝啬。

entries.example: Even our brains are subject to the laws of physics.
entries.translation: 就连我们的大脑也受物理定律的支配。

entries.example: His belief is rooted in experience.
entries.translation: 他的信念源于经验。

entries.example: The new policy could open the door to more foreign investment.
entries.translation: 这项新政策可能为更多外国投资打开大门。

entries.example: He is an excellent fixer, and has always been regarded as such.
entries.translation: 他是一位出色的调解人，一直被人们这样看待。

entries.example: Prior to the meeting, they had dinner.
entries.translation: 会议之前，他们吃了晚饭。

entries.example: Typewriters are giving way to word-processors.
entries.translation: 打字机正逐渐被文字处理机取代。

entries.example: This problem arose from a mutual misunderstanding.
entries.translation: 这个问题源于双方的误解。

entries.example: Its author is little more than a college kid.
entries.translation: 其作者不过是个大学生。

entries.example: The activity of foreign trade has been declining of late.
entries.translation: 最近对外贸易活动一直在减少。

entries.example: John finished the work at the expense of his health.
entries.translation: 约翰以牺牲自己的健康为代价完成了这项工作。

entries.example: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
entries.translation: 弗兰克用暗号留下了一条信息。

entries.example: Mr Ford is what is called a self-made man.
entries.translation: 福特先生就是所谓的白手起家者。

entries.example: He was subjected to severe criticism.
entries.translation: 他受到了严厉的批评。

entries.example: He is not a cheerful guy, to say the least.
entries.translation: 退一步说，他算不上是个开朗的人。

entries.example: She came to Tokyo with a view to getting a new job.
entries.translation: 她为了找新工作而来到东京。

entries.example: These disputes between the two nations should be solved in accordance with international law.
entries.translation: 这两个国家之间的争端应当依照国际法解决。

entries.example: This program was very popular so the information that it went off the air caused a wave of protest.
entries.translation: 这个节目非常受欢迎，所以它停播的消息引发了一阵抗议。

entries.example: I can't go along with you on that point.
entries.translation: 在这一点上，我不能同意你的看法。

entries.example: Since you're a member of this sports club, you'll have to conform to its rules.
entries.translation: 既然你是这个体育俱乐部的成员，就必须遵守它的规则。

entries.example: He adhered to the original plan.
entries.translation: 他坚持原来的计划。

entries.example: I have nothing to say with regard to that problem.
entries.translation: 对于那个问题，我没什么可说的。

entries.example: Latin American novels are characterized by their contrasts.
entries.translation: 拉美小说以对比鲜明为特征。

entries.example: To make matters worse, it began to rain.
entries.translation: 更糟的是，天开始下雨了。

entries.example: The accident was caused by the error on the part of the driver.
entries.translation: 这起事故是由司机的失误造成的。

entries.example: I felt ill and was admitted to the hospital, but in the event, it was nothing serious.
entries.translation: 我感到不舒服，被送进了医院，但结果并不严重。

entries.example: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.
entries.translation: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。

entries.example: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.
entries.translation: 你的行为还有很多有待改进之处。

entries.example: For me, reading at home is preferable to reading sitting beside strangers in a library.
entries.translation: 对我来说，在家里阅读比在图书馆里坐在陌生人旁边阅读更可取。

entries.example: He was in error in assuming that she would come to see him.
entries.translation: 他错误地以为她会来看他。

entries.example: In Britain a truck is referred to as a lorry.
entries.translation: 在英国，卡车被称为“lorry”。

entries.example: Good technicians are in short supply in the developing countries.
entries.translation: 发展中国家缺少优秀的技术人员。

entries.example: In the case of fire, dial 119.
entries.translation: 遇到火警时，拨打119。

entries.example: These bacteria have mutated into forms that are resistant to certain drugs.
entries.translation: 这些细菌已经变异成对某些药物有抗药性的形态。

entries.example: The celebrations culminated in a spectacular fireworks display.
entries.translation: 庆祝活动在壮观的烟花表演中达到高潮。

entries.example: What do you think came to pass here?
entries.translation: 你觉得这儿发生了什么事？

entries.example: It is a great joy to see your own sentences translated into a multitude of other languages.
entries.translation: 看到自己的句子被翻译成其他多种语言，是一件很开心的事。

entries.example: Our garden produced an abundance of cabbages last year.
entries.translation: 去年我们的菜园收获了大量的卷心菜。

entries.example: Latin American novels are characterized by their contrasts.
entries.translation: 拉丁美洲小说以对比鲜明为特色。

entries.example: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
entries.translation: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

entries.example: From the outset I was prepared for the worst.
entries.translation: 从一开始我就做好了最坏的打算。

entries.example: In regard to the schedule, I'll let you know later.
entries.translation: 关于日程安排，我稍后告诉你。

entries.example: Few people take the trouble to read all the terms and conditions of a contract before signing it.
entries.translation: 很少有人会费心在签署合同前读完所有条款和条件。

entries.example: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
entries.translation: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该修改我们的计划。

entries.example: The lecture was very long, but I enjoyed it none the less.
entries.translation: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。

entries.example: No one knows when such a custom came into existence.
entries.translation: 没有人知道这种习俗是何时形成的。

entries.example: The bill was passed by an overwhelming majority.
entries.translation: 这项法案以压倒性多数获得通过。

entries.example: In the absence of sufficient proof, the police could not indict him.
entries.translation: 由于缺乏充分证据，警方无法起诉他。

entries.example: I cannot agree with you as regards the new plan.
entries.translation: 关于这个新计划，我不能同意你的看法。

entries.example: The company has a strong track record of delivering projects on time.
entries.translation: 这家公司在按时交付项目方面有着良好的过往记录。

entries.example: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
entries.translation: 她凭借努力和商业头脑致富。

entries.example: In all likelihood, you will pass the entrance exam if you use this textbook.
entries.translation: 如果你使用这本教材，你很可能通过入学考试。

entries.example: You can't keep living in this manner.
entries.translation: 你不能一直这样生活下去。

entries.example: In this regard, I agree with you.
entries.translation: 在这方面，我同意你的看法。

entries.example: We had a fiery debate in this respect.
entries.translation: 我们在这方面进行了激烈的辩论。

entries.example: He is very strong--so much so that no one can defeat him.
entries.translation: 他非常强壮，以至于没人能打败他。

entries.example: She ignored the doctor's advice and, in consequence, her condition got worse.
entries.translation: 她无视医生的建议，结果病情加重了。

entries.example: His unique perspective helped shed light on the situation.
entries.translation: 他独特的视角有助于阐明这一情况。

entries.example: The weather improved considerably during the course of the day.
entries.translation: 这一天中天气明显好转了。

entries.example: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
entries.translation: 红色相对于绿色而言，是危险的标志。

entries.example: She was susceptible to colds.
entries.translation: 她易患感冒。

entries.example: Gold prices are skyrocketing in the wake of financial instability.
entries.translation: 金融动荡之后，黄金价格暴涨。

entries.example: The minister had to face a barrage of questions from the press.
entries.translation: 部长不得不面对媒体连珠炮般的提问。

entries.example: Many people find it difficult to remember a sequence of more than seven numbers.
entries.translation: 许多人发现，很难记住一个超过七个数字的序列。

entries.example: Benedito felt a surge of affection for his billy goat as it nuzzled against his hand.
entries.translation: 贝内迪托的山羊用鼻子蹭他的手时，他心里涌起一阵喜爱之情。

entries.example: As compared with last summer, we haven't had so much rain this year.
entries.translation: 与去年夏天相比，今年我们这里的雨水没有那么多。

entries.example: A dog is distinct from a cat in physical characteristics.
entries.translation: 狗在身体特征上与猫不同。

entries.example: The facts are incompatible with your hypothesis.
entries.translation: 这些事实与你的假设相矛盾。

entries.example: I don't like to be indebted to anyone.
entries.translation: 我不喜欢欠任何人的情。

entries.example: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
entries.translation: 熊猫原产于四川省，在其他任何地方的野外都不生活。

entries.example: They are oblivious to their fate.
entries.translation: 他们对自己的命运浑然不觉。

entries.example: Your plans will never come to fruition unless you make them more realistic.
entries.translation: 除非你把计划订得更现实一些，否则它们永远不会实现。

entries.example: At the outset of the long voyage I was seasick, but I gradually began to get my sea legs.
entries.translation: 长途航行刚开始时，我晕船，但渐渐适应了。

entries.example: After a succession of warm days, the weather became cold.
entries.translation: 连续几天温暖之后，天气变冷了。

entries.example: The story is not in accord with the facts.
entries.translation: 这个故事与事实不符。

entries.example: In actuality, it's not as scary as it seems.
entries.translation: 实际上，它并不像看起来那么可怕。

entries.example: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
entries.translation: 这超出了我的想象范围。

entries.example: Trains stopped in consequence of the heavy rain.
entries.translation: 由于大雨，火车停运了。

entries.example: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
entries.translation: 货车的载货量超过三吨。

entries.example: He often acted without regard to the feelings of others.
entries.translation: 他常常不顾别人的感受行事。

entries.example: The store offers an array of fresh produce.
entries.translation: 这家商店提供各种新鲜农产品。

entries.example: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
entries.translation: 这件事至关重要。

entries.example: I want to speak to her in the matter of my salary.
entries.translation: 我想跟她谈谈我的薪水问题。

entries.example: Insofar as we know, he is guilty.
entries.translation: 就我们所知，他有罪。

entries.example: Such being the case, I can't go with you.
entries.translation: 既然如此，我不能和你一起去。

entries.example: His request was tantamount to a threat.
entries.translation: 他的要求无异于威胁。

entries.example: He made reference to my book.
entries.translation: 他提到了我的书。

entries.example: It's totally without precedent for the suspect's attorney to be the true culprit.
entries.translation: 嫌疑人的律师竟然是真正的罪魁祸首，这完全史无前例。
